description: This file defines a React functional component 'RecipeCard' that renders a visual preview of a recipe, including image, title, rating, description, cuisine, difficulty, and prep time. It utilizes external UI components 'Card' and 'Badge' and references the 'Recipe' type from an API definitions file.

methods.name: RecipeCard
methods.description: React functional component rendering a recipe preview card with click and keyboard accessibility handlers.
